scenes.title: Proem
scenes.summary: The poet asks the goddess to sing the wrath of Achilles and its cost, from the day he and Agamemnon first quarreled.

scenes.title: The Priest and the Plague
scenes.summary: Chryses comes to ransom his daughter, is driven off by Agamemnon, and prays to Apollo, who shoots plague into the camp for nine days.

scenes.title: The Assembly
scenes.summary: On the tenth day Achilles calls an assembly. Under Achilles’ protection Calchas names the cause; Agamemnon agrees to return Chryseis but demands a replacement prize.

scenes.title: The Quarrel
scenes.summary: Achilles and Agamemnon trade insults and threats. Achilles vows to sail home; Agamemnon swears to take Briseis.

scenes.title: Athena Restrains Achilles
scenes.summary: As Achilles draws his sword, Athena, sent by Hera and seen by him alone, seizes his hair and persuades him to fight with words instead.

scenes.title: The Oath on the Scepter
scenes.summary: Achilles swears on the scepter of justice that the Achaeans will one day long for him, and hurls it to the ground.

scenes.title: Nestor’s Counsel
scenes.summary: Nestor recalls the heroes of his youth who fought the Centaurs, and urges both men to yield. Neither does.

scenes.title: Chryseis Sent Home
scenes.summary: The assembly breaks up. Odysseus sails with Chryseis and a hecatomb; the army purifies itself and sacrifices on the shore.

scenes.title: The Taking of Briseis
scenes.summary: Agamemnon’s heralds come for Briseis. Achilles greets them courteously and has Patroclus hand her over.

scenes.title: Achilles and Thetis
scenes.summary: Weeping by the sea, Achilles calls his mother, retells his wrongs, and asks her to supplicate Zeus, reminding him how she once saved him from bondage.

scenes.title: Odysseus at Chryse
scenes.summary: Odysseus returns Chryseis to her father. Chryses prays for the plague to end; the Achaeans sacrifice, feast, and sing the paean, then sail back to the camp.

scenes.title: Achilles Withdraws
scenes.summary: Achilles nurses his wrath by the ships, staying away from assembly and war, and longing for battle.

scenes.title: Thetis Supplicates Zeus
scenes.summary: On the twelfth day Thetis clasps Zeus’ knees. After a long silence he nods assent, and Olympus shakes.

scenes.title: Zeus and Hera
scenes.summary: Hera guesses what has been promised and taunts Zeus, who silences her with a threat of violence.

scenes.title: Hephaestus and the Feast of the Gods
scenes.summary: Hephaestus reconciles his mother to Zeus, recalling his own fall to Lemnos, and pours nectar amid unquenchable laughter. The gods feast until sunset and go to bed.

days.label: Days 1–9
days.note: Chryses is refused; nine days of plague (1.53).

days.label: Day 10
days.note: Assembly and quarrel; Briseis taken; Thetis visits Achilles; Odysseus reaches Chryse and sacrifices. Zeus left for the Ethiopians the day before (1.424).

days.label: Day 11
days.note: Odysseus sails back to the camp.

days.label: Days 11–20
days.note: Achilles sits idle by the ships; the iterative verbs (πωλέσκετο, φθινύθεσκε) cover the gods’ absence.

days.label: Day 21
days.note: The twelfth dawn after Thetis’ visit: the gods return; Thetis supplicates Zeus; the quarrel and feast on Olympus.
